verdict.rationale: The evidence shows inbound connectors (150+ integrations) and bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets sync. That sync is a spreadsheet add-in workflow, not a documented export or API that lets a developer move forecasts, metrics, or scenario results into a warehouse or internal tool. No public API or OpenAPI spec was found: all candidate OpenAPI paths returned 404, and nothing describes warehouse write-back or outbound data export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull model outputs (metrics, forecasts, scenario results) into a warehouse or internal tool through a documented export or API
